mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Choose a guided object or write a raw GraphQL query.

options.tooltip: Guided mode extracts one Medallia connection with a picked field set and optional incremental load. Raw mode runs a GraphQL query you author (always a full load).

data_object.title: Data Object
data_object.description: Medallia connection to extract into one table.

options.tooltip: Auto-populated from the instance schema. If introspection is disabled you can type an object name manually (e.g. feedback, customers, programs).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields to extract; leave empty to take all scalar fields.

options.tooltip: Shows field names for the chosen object; each becomes one output column. The list reloads when the object changes. Empty selects all scalar fields (for objects without a field catalogue).

raw_query.title: Raw GraphQL Query
raw_query.description: A GraphQL query returning exactly one paginated connection.

options.tooltip: Must declare $first and $after variables (with your connection's ACTUAL argument types — on Medallia these are typically first: Int! and after: ID, not Int/String), pass them to exactly one top-level connection, and select nodes { … } and pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }. The component injects first/after (after starts as null, then the endCursor) and pages via pageInfo, but runs your query verbatim without rewriting variable types. Raw mode is always a full load; embed your own date filter for incremental extraction.

output_table.title: Storage Table Name
output_table.description: Optional. Defaults to the data object name.

options.tooltip: Optional. Name of the output table; defaults to the data object name. Set a distinct name to extract the same object multiple ways in one configuration.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Write mode: Incremental upserts by primary key; Full Load overwrites the table.

options.tooltip: How the table is written: Incremental Load keeps a watermark and upserts rows by primary key (adds/updates); Full Load overwrites the whole table each run. Use the Date Field + Start Date to bound how far back either load reaches — this is NOT the same as load type.

incremental_field.title: Date Field
incremental_field.description: Date field the Start Date filters on (and, for incremental, the watermark).

options.tooltip: The date/datetime field (or sortable numeric timestamp) that the Start Date bounds the extraction on. Applies to both load types. For incremental loads it is also tracked as the watermark. The value format is auto-detected. Leave empty to load the whole object unbounded.

initial_start.title: Start Date
initial_start.description: Only fetch records with the Date Field on/after this; empty loads full history.

options.tooltip: Lower bound on the Date Field, applied to BOTH load types — Full Load overwrites the table from this point; Incremental seeds the first run and then resumes from the watermark. Accepts an ISO date (e.g. 2026-01-01), epoch seconds, or a relative expression such as 'yesterday', '5 days ago', or 'last monday'. Leave empty to load full history. (Requires a Date Field.)

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional Medallia filter tree as JSON.

options.tooltip: A Medallia filter tree (JSON), AND-joined with the incremental watermark. A leaf clause is {"fieldIds": ["<field id>"], "<op>": <value>} where <op> is one of eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, isNull; combine leaves with and / or / not. Example: {"and": [{"fieldIds": ["e_creationdate"], "gte": "2026-01-01"}, {"fieldIds": ["a_survey_channel"], "in": ["web", "email"]}]}. Field ids come from the Load Fields picker. Full grammar: Medallia Query API 'Filter and sort' docs (see the component's Documentation link). Leave empty for no extra filtering.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Records per request; capped at the Medallia maximum of 1000.

options.tooltip: The first argument sent on every query. Defaults to 100; values above the Medallia maximum of 1000 are clamped.
